title: Four coefficientwise section operators for a two-parameter translation commutator
statement: Let S be an arbitrary scheme and G/S a group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. Let v,w be points over S[epsilon] reducing to the identity [def-sc-dual-numbers]. For every open U of G put R=Gamma(U,O_G), and let D_v,D_w be the epsilon coefficients of right translation by v,w on R. Write a double dual number as (a00+epsilon a10)+delta(a01+epsilon a11). Define E_D to send its four coefficients to (a00,a10+D(a00),a01,a11+D(a01)), and F_D to send them to (a00,a10,a01+D(a00),a11+D(a10)). For z=v_epsilon w_delta v_epsilon^{-1} w_delta^{-1}, right translation of the universal G-point by z has, on every constant section a of R, comorphism E_{D_v}(F_{D_w}(E_{-D_v}(F_{-D_w}(a)))). This is equality in R[epsilon][delta], before mixed-coefficient extraction. The translation is the explicit product of the universal point and z pulled back along G[epsilon][delta] to S[epsilon][delta]. No affine, field, characteristic, or smoothness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Construct the parameter-preserving lift of right translation to G[epsilon][delta] by applying Scheme.isPullback_dualNumbersProj twice. Its composite with the two projections is the original right translation, and its composite with G.hom[epsilon][delta] is that structure morphism. The two pullback universal properties also give extensionality for such endomorphisms. These are the proved private liftedTwoParameterTranslation, projection, parameter, and double_hom_ext helpers.

Let p be the universal point and k the parameter morphism. A lifted translation F_z satisfies F_z composed with p = p*(k composed with z), and F_z composed with k = k. Precomposition preserves multiplication and multiplication is associative. Double pullback extensionality therefore gives F_z composed with F_t = F_(z*t). For epsilon and delta points, factoring their underlying translations through the corresponding projection to G[epsilon] identifies their pullback on constant functions with the one-parameter right-translation pullback. Reduction of the latter is the identity and its second coefficient is invariantCoefficient by definition.

The structure-map equation fixes epsilon and delta on global sections: the double dual-number extension of G.hom sends each parameter to itself. Restriction naturality proves this on each open. Write an arbitrary double dual number as the sum of its four constant coefficients times 1, epsilon, delta, and epsilon*delta. The ring-homomorphism laws, the constant-function formulas, and the fixed-parameter equations give epsilonSectionAction for an epsilon lift and deltaSectionAction for a delta lift, on every section, not only constants. This is proved by four_coefficients, epsilon_formula, delta_formula, and their geometric applications.

Additivity and the zero coefficient of the identity give D_(v inverse) = -D_v by applying invariantCoefficient_mul to v*v inverse. Precomposition with either parameter projection preserves inverses. Apply the composition law successively to the four lifted factors. Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE gives contravariant composition on sections, with the epsilon action of v outermost. The double projection sends a to inl(inl(a)); its composite with the lifted word is the explicit twoParameterRightTranslation. Compose the four single-factor formulas and substitute the two inverse-coefficient identities. Proof irrelevance makes the equality independent of the supplied open-inclusion proof e.

proof_origin.place: Invariant-extension and mixed-coefficient steps, implemented using the existing dual-number pullback and coefficient-addition theorems; all local geometric and ring-theoretic glue is proved.

theorem twoParameterRightTranslation_commutator_app
    (v w : infPoints G) (U : G.left.Opens)
    (e : U ≤ (twoParameterRightTranslation G
      ((Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1) * (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1) *
        (Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1)⁻¹ *
          (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1)⁻¹)) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (a : Γ(G.left, U)) :
    (twoParameterRightTranslation G
      ((Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1) * (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1) *
        (Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1)⁻¹ *
          (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1)⁻¹)).appLE U U e a =
      epsilonSectionAction (invariantCoefficient G v U)
        (deltaSectionAction (invariantCoefficient G w U)
          (epsilonSectionAction (-invariantCoefficient G v U)
            (deltaSectionAction (-invariantCoefficient G w U) (inl (inl a)))))
